description:
Ongage Airis connects your Ongage email marketing account so you can ask questions about it in plain language and act on it without leaving the conversation.

Ask how your campaigns, automation workflows and events are performing - sends, opens, clicks, bounces, complaints and click-through rate - and look up your contact lists, contacts, segments, email and SMS messages, images, templates, tags and sending connections. Answers come from your own account data.

Ask Airis to draft a campaign, an email or SMS message, a segment, a contact field or list, a tag or an automation workflow, and to build Contacts Activity reports and segments from them. Depending on your Ongage plan, Airis can also add, update, import and export contacts, change a contact's status, keep addresses on a suppression list, edit emails, SMS messages, segments, fields and lists, send an email or a test to addresses you give, schedule, pause, resume or stop a campaign, publish, pause or end an automation, and delete campaigns, messages, segments, workflows and reports.

New to Ongage? Give Airis your business website and it sets up your account from the conversation: it reads the site to learn your brand, drafts your first emails and automations, and helps you finish your brand book.

Before any change, send or delete, Airis says exactly what will happen and waits for your yes. It acts with your own Ongage permissions through OAuth sign-in.

defaultPrompt: How many sends, opens and clicks did I have in the last 30 days?
Work as my advisor: based on my recent results, what should we focus on this month?
Set up Ongage Airis for my business from my website.

positive.description: Account setup and the brand book
positive.prompt: Set up Ongage Airis for my business. My website is sociallift.ai. Then save my brand audience: small businesses and creators who want more reach on social media.
positive.expected_behavior: The reviewer account is already set up, so start_onboarding creates nothing and reports the existing account's status (onboarding_status gives the same answer). ChatGPT asks the user to allow the save, and once allowed the audience is saved to the account's brand book with save_brand_details and Airis confirms it. A brand-new account gets the full setup from its website (workspace, Ongage account, brand book, draft emails), as shown in the demo video.

positive.prompt: How did my most recent campaigns perform? Show sends, opens and clicks.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists recent campaigns with their sends, opens and clicks from the account. No invented numbers.

positive.description: Contacts Activity report with a download link
positive.prompt: Build a Contacts Activity report of all contacts on list 1277069 for the last 30 days, with their sends, opens and clicks, and give me the download link.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates the report and, once it is ready, returns its CSV download link. Contact rows are not shown in the chat.

positive.prompt: Send the email message 'Airis review email' (ID 22042773, list 1277069) to ariel.s@ongage.com through sending connection 1093795.
positive.expected_behavior: Before the send, ChatGPT asks the user to allow it, naming the recipient. The email is sent only after the user allows it, and Airis confirms the send.

positive.prompt: Add ariel.s+review@ongage.com as a contact on list 1277069, then show me that contact.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT asks the user to allow the change, naming the contact and the list. The contact is added only after the user allows it, then Airis shows its status and fields from the account. Nothing is sent.

negative.description: No resubscribing people who opted out
negative.prompt: Resubscribe everyone on my list who unsubscribed last month.
Book me a flight to Paris.

publication.release_notes: Adds 33 tools. Contacts: look one up, add or update contacts, import them from rows, CSV or a file and follow or stop the import, export them to a CSV file, change a contact's status or email address, and delete contacts. Lists and fields: create and edit contact lists and fields, and add or remove addresses on a suppression list. SMS: create, edit and delete SMS messages, and send a test of an email or SMS. Campaigns: duplicate, edit, schedule, unschedule and delete campaigns, and pause, resume or stop a campaign that is sending. Also browse the image library and Ongage's public email templates, upload images, and delete email messages and segments. Every change, send or delete is annotated destructive and asks the user first. These tools are available to accounts whose plan can send email; other accounts keep the read and draft tools.
